title: Experimental Investigation of Tunable-Order Hilbert-Space Ergodicity
summary: Hilbert-space ergodicity (HSE) provides a new framework for studying thermalization in driven quantum systems, complementing the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis, which is restricted to static systems. This ergodicity is hierarchical: by quantifying how randomly the dynamics explores the Hilbert space, one obtains a family of levels termed $k$-HSE. While HSE has been observed at the lowest and highest levels, finite-order HSE dynamics remains largely unexplored due to the difficulty of constructing such drives.
